Toys 'R' Us to Open 120 New Stores in the U.S.

Toys 'R' Us is planning to open 120 new stores across the United States. The expansion is reportedly driven by increased toy sales, particularly among adult collectors. The new stores are expected to be operational in time for the holiday season.
